label: Wildfire Incidents & Perimeters → TAK
info:
Current wildfire incidents and their mapped fire perimeters. Fires that leave the feed are removed from the map.

Data: Esri USA Wildfires (NIFC data) (https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=d957997ccee7408287a963600a77f61f). Updates every 15 minutes.

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/wildfire-incidents
